quick_warnings: Stick to the Zona Dorada and historic centro; avoid venturing into outer colonias at night.
Rip currents are common on open-ocean beaches — swim only where lifeguards are present.
Rainy season (Jun–Oct) brings humidity and occasional hurricanes; check forecasts.

detail_guide.getting_around: The Malecón stretches over 20 km and is walkable or bikeable. Green-and-white pulmonías (open-air taxis) are the classic local transport. Uber is available. City buses run along main corridors but can be crowded.

parks.name: Isla de la Piedra (Stone Island)

eat_drink_work.name: Cervecería del Pacífico
